description: List where one Atlas Node references other entries (outbound) and where they reference it (inbound), outbound first. Use to find related entries or what points at this one. Each occurrence gives direction, class, source Section, and the far end's Hook (one-line summary), plus its id and title unless the class is 'undisclosed' (unpublished and unannounced). Results are paged: follow the cursor to the end before concluding nothing points here. An unknown or Roadmap-only (unpublished) subject is refused as invalid_argument.

bound.description: How many relationship occurrences this call returns; continue with cursor until the page is no longer truncated.

cursor.description: scope.next_cursor from a prior atlas_links page; repeat the same other arguments.

expected_revision.description: Pins this call to the Release (published edition) a prior payload named in 'coherence'; refused as 'revision_changed' if the active Release has changed. Omit for the active Release.

subject.description: A bare Node id (no '#section'), e.g. an atlas_orient candidate id or a Card id.

name: atlas_links

data.description: links: per occurrence, class ('in-slice', 'roadmap-disclosed', 'undisclosed'), direction, occurrence (section slug, ordinal), the far end's target id and title unless undisclosed, and its hook.

title: List an Atlas Node's Relationships
